title: Restructure into a monorepo: packages/core and apps/desktop

title: Move the prototype engine into packages/core with its tests
goal: The scheduler, grading, session planner, importers and exporters live in one tested package with no UI or Electron code.

title: Replace the local HTTP server with a typed Electron bridge (IPC)
goal: No network port is opened; only the app's own window can reach the data.

Renderer runs with contextIsolation, sandbox and no nodeIntegration
No listening socket when the app runs (test checks it)
The web dev mode keeps working through a thin adapter, or is removed with a note in the plan
notes: Media files are served through a custom protocol (e.g. lernlab-media://), not HTTP.
